description: Pre-signature verdict in ONE call: sign | review | do-not-sign | unknown for a Solana or EVM address, with per-source evidence and an explicit rule the agent can re-derive. Covers Solana, Base and Polygon; returns unknown (available=false) instead of a fake verdict when the chain cannot be verified. Pay-per-call ($0.01 USDC).

address.description: Solana base58 pubkey or 0x EVM address

amount.description: Optional transfer size in USD, to weight the verdict

name: sign_check
